blunt_te.description: Trailing-edge round percentage expressed as an x/chord trim location. The default 0.01 means the trim starts at x = 0.01 from the trailing edge.

d0.description: First-layer height in meters. Use a negative value to let the wrapper estimate it from `y_plus`, `mach_number`, and `reynolds_number`.

hyperbolic_sweeps.description: Number of smoothing sweeps per layer for hyperbolic extrusion.

neighbor_rings.description: Neighbor-ring depth used by the hyperbolic extrusion smoother.

diffuse_start.description: Smoothing onset distance in meters. Hyperbolic diffusion stays off until this marched distance, then starts ramping up.

max_aspect_ratio_pass.description: Pass threshold for maximum aspect ratio.

max_aspect_ratio_warning.description: Warning threshold for maximum aspect ratio.

transonic_mach_boundary.description: Transonic Mach split used by the default solver selection when `solver_name` is not set.

solver_name.description: Explicit solver override. Set this when the user asks for a specific solver. Supported values are `DASimpleFoam` (incompressible), `DARhoSimpleFoam` (compressible), `DARhoSimpleCFoam` (compressible/transonic), and `DAHisaFoam` (compressible/transonic/supersonic). Leave unset, `null`, or `none` to use the default Mach-based selection.

turbulence_model.description: OpenFOAM RANS turbulence model. Supported values are `SpalartAllmaras` (SA) and `kOmegaSST` (SST).

use_wall_functions.description: Wall-function selection. Use `auto` to choose from mesh settings, `1` to force enable, or `0` to force disable. In auto mode, explicit positive `d0` disables wall functions; otherwise y_plus >= 5 enables them.

max_flow_iters.description: Maximum number of flow iterations written to the case controlDict endTime/writeInterval settings.

n_cst_coeffs.description: Number of CST coefficients per surface used when prepare fits CST coefficients. For example, `6` means 6 upper and 6 lower coefficients.

primal_func_std_tol.description: DAFoam primal function standard deviation tolerance passed to script_run_dafoam.py.

primal_func_slope_tol.description: DAFoam primal function slope tolerance passed to script_run_dafoam.py.

force_std_pass.description: Pass threshold for raw force-coefficient standard deviation.

force_std_warning.description: Warning threshold for raw force-coefficient standard deviation.

residual_drop_orders_pass.description: Pass threshold for minimum residual drop in log10 orders.

residual_drop_orders_warning.description: Warning threshold for minimum residual drop in log10 orders.

initialize_from.description: Warm-start lever (off by default). Case name of a previously converged CFD run whose flow field initializes this run instead of a uniform freestream; leave unset (null) for a cold start. Use it to help a hard case converge (high AoA, or a fine low-y+ mesh). The referenced case must have finished before this run.

cp_plot_upper_bound.description: Upper bound of the Cp axis and colorbar shared by the pressure-profile and Cp flow-field plots.

u_plot_lower_bound.description: Lower bound of the normalized velocity colorbar for the U flow-field plot.
